findings.explanation: The new GET /users/<int:user_id>/orders endpoint enforces authentication via @require_auth (satisfying security-policy.md §1) and verifies ownership with is_owner_or_admin(g.current_user, user_id), returning 403 otherwise. This matches api-spec.md ('/users/<id>/orders GET: owner or admin') and security-policy.md §3 ('Listing another user's orders is restricted to that user themselves and administrators'). is_owner_or_admin (app/auth.py:107-109) correctly returns user.id == owner_id or user.role == 'admin'. The query filters Order.user_id == user_id, so only the verified owner's orders are returned. No IDOR or missing/incorrect authorization.

evidence.content: Listing another user's orders is restricted to that user themselves and administrators.
